tex_content.html:
\begin{example} \end{example}[Cut Loci] 1. ch10:10.30

  1. For the round sphere $(S^n(R),\bar g_R)$, $\operatorname {Cut}(p)=\{ -p\} $.

  2. For $S^n(R)\times \mathbb R^m$ with the product metric,

    \[ \operatorname {Cut}(p,x)=\{ -p\} \times \mathbb R^m. \]

\end{example}
